content: Ccariɛa n Arebbi war tᵉttis ak-d tɣuri d tweṣṣa n iwdan
Řexdenni usin-dd imseřmaden n idlisen d Ifarisiyyen zi Urcalim ɣar Yasuɛ, nnan:
“Mayemmi ttɛeddan imeḥḍaren nnec x tubbart n imɣaren nneɣ. Nitni war ssiriden ca ifassen nsen qbeř i ɣa ccen aɣrum!”
Yarra-dd Yasuɛ, inna asen: “Mayemmi kenniw ɛawed tᵉttɛeddam x tewṣeyyet n AREBBI zi ssibbet n tubbart nwem?
Minzi AREBBI tuɣa inna: ‘Weqqar babac d yemmac!’ u: ‘Wenni i ɣa ixzan babas niɣ yemmas, ittxeṣṣa as ad immet!’

Maca kenniw teqqarem: ‘Marra wi ɣa yinin i babas niɣ i yemmas: Marra min tzemmarem ad zzayi tnefɛem, aqa ggiɣ t d tawhibt i Arebbi! Ammu netta war iḥdij ɛad ad iweqqar babas niɣ yemmas s marra man aya!’
Ammu tbeṭṭřem awař n AREBBI di ṭṭweɛ n tubbart nwem.
Kenniw, a imnafqen! Icaɛya tuɣa ittnabba xawem s ṣṣeḥ, inna:
‘Řgens-a ittcenneɛ ayi s iyencicen nsen, maca uř nsen iggʷej xafi.
Aqa nitni cennɛen ayi baṭeř, minzi nitni sseřmaden tiɣuriwin nni iǧan d tiweṣṣa n iwdan.’”
Řami d iřaɣa-dd x řɣaci ɣares, inna asen: “Sřem mliḥ, fehmem!
War iǧi min ittadfen deg uqemmum issexmej bnadem, maca min i dd-itteffɣen zeg uqemmum d man aya i issexmajen bnadem.”
Řexdenni usin-dd ɣares imeḥḍaren nnes, nnan as: “Ma tessned belli Ifarisiyyen nderfen di man aya, řami t sřin?”
Maca Netta yarra-dd, inna asen: “Kuř aɣeddu, war t iẓẓu Baba, wenni iǧan deg ijenwan, ad ittwaqřeɛ.
Ejj i-ten! Nitni d idarɣařen neddhen idarɣařen. Mařa adarɣař ineddeh adarɣař, ad wḍan s tnayen idsen deg weḥfur.”
Yarra-dd Cimɛun Buṭrus, inna as: “A Sidi, fessar aneɣ amedya-ya!”
Maca Yasuɛ inna asen: “Ma kenniw ɛad břa řefhamet ař řexxu?
Ma war tefhimem ca belli marra min ɣa yadfen deg uqemmum, ad iraḥ ɣar uɛeddis uca ssenni ad ittwassuffeɣ barra i usizdeg?
Maca min i dd-itteffɣen zeg uqemmum ittas-dd zeg wuř, aqa d man aya i issxemmajen bnadem.
Minzi zeg wuř n iwdan i dd-tteffɣen ixarriṣen iɛeffanen, zzina, anɣay, farq-ccɣeř, tuceffra, cchadat s ẓur d uceqqef.
Aqa d man aya min issxemmajen bnadem, maca macca s ifassen war issirden war tessxemmij ca bnadem.”
L’iman n temɣart zeg ayt n Kenɛan
Řexdenni iffeɣ-dd Yasuɛ ssenni, iruḥ ɣar jjwayeh n Ṣur d Ṣaydun.
U xzar, ict n temɣart zeg ayt n Kenɛan zi jjwayeh nni tesɣuy, tenna: “A Sidi, a Mmis n Dawud, arḥem ayi! Yeǧi aqa dayes cciṭan issnexřaɛen.”
Maca Netta war xas dd-yarri ca, uřa s yijj n wawař. Usin-dd ɣares imeḥḍaren nnes, ttaren zzayes, nnan: “Aẓẓeř xas, minzi nettat teḍfar aneɣ-dd s iɣuyyan.”
Netta yarra-dd, inna asen: “Necc ttwassekkeɣ-dd ɣar wuǧi iweddaren n taddart n Israil waha.”
Maca nettat tusa-dd, tesjed as, tenna: “A Sidi, ɛawen ayi!”
Maca Netta yarra-dd, inna: “War iɛeddeř ad immeksi weɣrum n iḥenjiren, maḥend ad immenḍar i yiṭan.”
Maca nettat tenna: “Wah, a Sidi, maɣar uřa d iṭan ttᵉtten iřeqqwaz i dd-iweṭṭan zi ṭṭabřa n siditsen uca ttɣiman ddaren.”
Řexdenni inna as Yasuɛ: “A tamɣart, l’iman nnem imɣar! Ad yiři am mammec řxaḍar nnem.” Uca yeǧis teggenfa di tsaɛɛet nni.
Asgenfi n ineɛḍab, idařɣaren, ignawen d iqejdaḥen
Uca yuyur Yasuɛ ssenni, yiweḍ-dd ɣar tma n řebḥar n Ljalil, igeɛɛed ɣar wedrar, iqqim dinni.
Yusa-dd ɣares ijj n ubarru ameqqran n řɣaci, iwyen-dd akidsen ineɛḍaben d idarɣařen d ignawen d iqejdaḥen d inneɣni aṭṭas, ssarsen ten ɣar iḍaren n Yasuɛ uca issgenfa ten,
ařami itebhet řɣaci, aqa ẓrin ignawen ssawařen, iqejdaḥen ggenfan, ineɛḍaben gguren, idarɣařen ttwařan, uca ssɛuǧen AREBBI n Israil.
Lmuɛjiza n usecci i twařa wiss tnayen
Yasuɛ iřaɣa-dd x imeḥḍaren nnes, inna asen: “Ḥinneɣ x řɣaci minzi qqimen akidi třata n wussan, war ɣarsen min ɣa ccen. War xseɣ ca ad ten ssqebbḍeɣ ttẓuman, ḥima war tteḍɛifen ca deg webrid.”
Nnan as imeḥḍaren nnes: “Manis d ɣa nawi aɣrum di řexřa-ya i zi ɣa nessecc ijj n řɣaci d ameqqran am wanita?”
Inna asen Yasuɛ: “Mecḥař ɣarwem d aɣrum?” Nnan as: “Sebɛa n tecnifin d ca n iseřman imeẓyanen.”
Xenni yumur řɣaci, ḥima ad qqimen di temmurt.
Iksi sebɛa n tecnifin d iseřman nni, iqada, yarẓa i-tent uca iwca i-tent i imeḥḍaren nnes uca imeḥḍaren wcin tent i iwdan.
Marra ccin, jjiwnen. Xenni yarwen-dd iřeqqwaz iceṭṭen: tuɣa din sebɛa n tsuǧatin ɛemmarent.
Inni tuɣa iccen aqa aten di arebɛa ařaf n yeryazen břa timɣarin d iḥenjiren.
Awarni řami issqebbeḍ řɣaci, inya deg uɣarrabu uca yiweḍ ɣar weymir n jjwayeh n Magdu.
